text:
The gates are wired the wrong way around.

- M1 is the input device. Its gate is tied to iout, so it is not diode-connected. With iout held at 0.9 V, M1 sits in triode and pulls iin down to about 0.02 V.
- M2's gate is tied to iin, which is only about 0.02 V. That is below threshold, so M2 is off and iout is about 0.

The intended mirror has both gates on iin: M1 diode-connected, M2 mirroring it. Swapping M1's gate from iout to iin fixes this.

```json
{"ranking": ["M1", "M2"], "fault": "M1 gate miswired to iout instead of iin (not diode-connected); M1 goes to triode, iin collapses to ~0.02 V, M2 turns off and iout is ~0"}
```
